ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle area and dense lateral mottling, versus 35% high-intensity (white) background pixels on the outer lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, solid dark contiguous mass occupies the central 30% of the fluke. The remaining lateral surfaces are characterized by a dense matrix of small (variable 3-15 pixel diameter) dark irregular blobs distributed uniformly against a white background, with higher density clusters near the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A symmetrical, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate vertex angle of 45-55 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary; the right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (jaggedness) compared to the relatively smoother, low-amplitude serrations of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a straight, slightly upward-sloping linear trajectory towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular and sub-circular dark-on-white pixel clusters scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes, indicative of extensive historical colonization sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular indentation and possible tissue loss at the terminal point of the right distal tip, creating a non-symmetrical profile compared to the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern where dark pigment dominates the trailing edge margins more heavily than the leading edge margins.
